image.subject: 民進黨基隆市長參選人童子瑋
image.sourceCaption: 民進黨基隆市長參選人童子瑋（右）12日接受中廣流行網「趙少康時間」主持人趙少康（左）專訪，針對基隆捷運第2階段規劃，提出「市區雙鐵共構、安樂直通大武崙」雙主線構想。（童子瑋進步基隆辦公室提供）中央社記者王朝鈺傳真　115年10月12日

zh.title: 童子瑋提出基隆捷運第二階段雙主線構想
zh.summary: 童子瑋提出基隆捷運市區共構與安樂線延伸大武崙構想
body: 基隆市長參選人童子瑋接受專訪時，提出基隆捷運第二階段「市區雙鐵共構、安樂直通大武崙」雙主線構想。市區路線將利用既有臺鐵路廊，以高架或地下方式導入捷運，讓臺鐵與捷運並存。安樂線則規劃延伸至大武崙，串聯產業園區，兼顧通勤及地方產業發展。
童子瑋表示，若採大規模隧道開挖，施工難度較高，建設時間與工程風險也較難掌握。他主張運用已完成相關環評程序的臺鐵路廊，並評估高架、地下及臨時軌施工方式，在不中斷既有鐵路功能的前提下，形成市區雙鐵共構系統。

en.title: Keelung candidate 童子瑋 proposes two-line metro concept
en.summary: Candidate 童子瑋 proposes a Keelung metro concept linking the city corridor with 大武崙.
body: Keelung mayoral candidate 童子瑋 proposed a two-line concept for the second phase of the Keelung Metro in an interview. It combines a city-area rail and metro interchange with an Anle line extending directly to 大武崙. Under the proposal, the urban route would use the existing Taiwan Railways corridor, bringing metro service in through elevated or underground construction while allowing both systems to operate.

童子瑋 also proposed extending the Anle line to 大武崙 and connecting it with industrial parks. He said large-scale tunnel excavation could be difficult to build, with construction time and engineering risks harder to manage. He proposed assessing elevated, underground and temporary-track construction methods while maintaining existing railway functions.

zh.title: 西班牙直升機營運商Eliance申請初步債權人保護
zh.summary: Eliance申請初步債權人保護，未來取決於與債權人的協商。
body: 西班牙直升機營運商Eliance已申請初步債權人保護。AeroTime報導稱，這項程序距將公司置於司法監管僅一步之遙；報導並指出，申請與Eliance財務困境及據稱的短期流動性問題有關。
報導指出，Eliance在2025財年的淨虧損較前一財年增加一倍，由€12 million升至€24 million，營收約為€54 million。AeroTime另稱，公司有意繼續營運，但未來取決於與債權人的協商結果。

en.title: Spanish helicopter operator Eliance files for preliminary creditor protection
en.summary: Eliance files for preliminary creditor protection as its future depends on talks with creditors.
body: Spanish helicopter operator Eliance has filed for preliminary creditor protection. AeroTime says the move is one step short of placing the business under judiciary supervision and was prompted by Eliance’s troubled financial situation, with reported short-term liquidity issues.

In fiscal year 2025, the company doubled its net loss from the preceding year, from €12 million to €24 million, and reported total revenue of approximately €54 million. AeroTime also reports that there is interest in continuing operations, while the company’s future depends on the outcome of negotiations with its creditors.

zh.title: 印度A321neo客機乘客應對頭頂行李櫃行動電源起火，航班改道
zh.summary: 印度A321neo客機乘客應對頭頂行李櫃行動電源起火，航班被迫改道
body: Simple Flying報導，印度A321neo客機上的乘客在頭頂行李櫃應對行動電源起火。報導標題稱，飛機被迫改道；摘要則說，旅客當時正在印度境內行程中，並努力阻止火焰蔓延。
標題與摘要未列出航空公司名稱，也未提供事件發生日，因此無法據此確認營運業者或事件日期。現有資訊只說明乘客應對行動電源起火及飛機改道，沒有提供其他可確認的營運細節。

en.title: Passengers Battle Power Bank Fire Aboard Indian A321neo; Flight Diverts
en.summary: Indian A321neo passengers battle an overhead-bin power bank fire; the aircraft diverts.
body: Simple Flying reported that passengers aboard an Indian A321neo battled a power bank fire in an overhead bin. The headline says the aircraft was forced to divert. The summary describes the flight as a trip across India and says travelers struggled to stop the flames from spreading.

The headline and summary do not identify the airline or give the occurrence date, so neither is specified here. The reported details are limited to the fire, passengers’ response and the diversion; no further operational details are provided in the available material.
